items.title: Edgar "Sambo" Joseph Interview, 1960-08-07
items.q: I played with what you call this boy George Williams.

ctx.x: You still play them? Yeah, I still play them. With John Cadme.

Oh yeah. I played with John. I played with what you call this boy George Williams. You know. Well I tell you the truth, I'm going to be straight and tell you about them parades. That sun's been a little too hot man. I didn't know you were walking all that hot sun like that. It's hot in that sun man. It's always in the summertime. Yeah, it's hot in the summertime. It's hot. In the wintertime it was cool. I don't mind making it. Man, you know, do you know sometimes you be playing a parade, you know you can feel…

You were talking about this street here used to be rocking. That's right, this would be rocking. Did you ever take parades on the streets like that? Sure they come through here. Sure they come through that. How did that affect you when you were marching playing? Just walking on the rocks is all you had to take and do.
